tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: near-black with a green cast. Every page starts here.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on background, surface, surface-elevated (≥14:1).

tokens.name: body-text
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy on background, surface and surface-elevated (≥7:1).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, eyebrows on background (5.2:1) and surface (4.8:1). Only 4.25:1 on surface-elevated — use it there at 24px+ or switch to body-text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section bands and panels one step above background.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised panels, hover fills and inputs inside a surface.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card fill (same as surface); pair with gradient-metal for the brushed 3D card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select dropdowns, the support-chat panel.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: EzyMap green: primary CTAs, live/active states, links, eyebrows. As text on background 8.2:1.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (8:1).

tokens.name: primary-glow
tokens.usage: Deep EzyMap green: the dark end of gradient-green and button bevels; large dark-green fills. Never as text on dark grounds (3.6:1); foreground on it reads 4.9:1.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Faint green wash behind chips, selected rows and active tabs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: EzyMap gold: outline CTAs, prices, premium tiers, focus rings, numerals. As text on background 8.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (7.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Dark end of gradient-gold; pressed gold.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Faint gold wash behind premium badges and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary fills (tabs, segmented controls).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted fills: skeletons, disabled backgrounds.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions use gold, not red — the palette stays green/gold/black/white. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline on every card, input and divider.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hairline on hover.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Ring token from the theme. Buttons draw their focus ring in accent (gold) with a background offset.

tokens.name: market-up
tokens.usage: Price up, winning trade, long.

tokens.name: market-down
tokens.usage: Price down, losing trade, short — gold, not red. Always pair with an arrow or sign; up and down differ by hue alone.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Signal status breakeven and cancelled (SignalFlag). On background ≈6:1.

tokens.name: status-stop
tokens.usage: Signal status stopped (stop-loss hit) — the only red in the system, SignalFlag only. Always with the word "Stopped".

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Perspective grid floors and HUD grids behind hero objects. Decorative only, never under body text.

tokens.name: frame-line
tokens.usage: HudFrame hairline. Its corner brackets use accent at full strength.

tokens.name: holo-edge
tokens.usage: Border of the holo card, the one panel per view that holds the key action or checklist.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Professional trading signals, delivered live to your phone.
styles.usage: The one h1 per page (34px on mobile).

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Everything lands in one Telegram feed

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Forex, commodities and crypto analysis from a 10-year veteran trader.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The workhorse UI size: card copy, lists, button md.

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 scale: 1 step = 0.25rem (4px). Steps listed are the ones the site uses most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Flag dot gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and chips; button sm vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button md vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; button lg vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; button sm horizontal padding; stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); button md horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button lg horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Min height, button sm.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Min height, button md (touch target).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Min height, button lg.

radius.note: Derived from --radius: 0.5rem (calc values resolved at 16px root).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book covers, small tags. calc(var(--radius) - 4px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, the neon CTA. calc(var(--radius) - 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons sm/md, small cards. = --radius.

tokens.name: radius-button-lg
tokens.usage: Button lg (rounded-[10px]).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards. calc(var(--radius) + 4px).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, modals. calc(var(--radius) + 8px).

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large showcase panels. calc(var(--radius) + 12px).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: SignalFlag, HeroPill, avatars.

shadow.note: Neutral depth plus inset sheen is what makes surfaces read as 3D. Coloured glow is reserved for the primary button, lifted cards and the single holo panel per view.

tokens.name: shadow-gold
tokens.usage: Minimal lift under gold elements.

tokens.name: shadow-green
tokens.usage: Minimal lift under green elements.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Three-layer depth for floating panels and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: The glass-card: top-edge highlight, bottom bevel, deep drop. Use with gradient-metal.

tokens.name: shadow-button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button bevel and green halo.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: card-lift hover: card rises 3px and picks up a green underglow.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: 3D ebook cover drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-holo
tokens.usage: Holo card: green edge glow plus deep drop. One per view.

gradient.note: Brushed-metal and bevel fills. Neutral surfaces, never colourful backgrounds.

tokens.name: gradient-hero
tokens.usage: Hero section ground.

tokens.name: gradient-metal
tokens.usage: Brushed-metal card fill (glass-card, gradient-card).

tokens.name: gradient-gold
tokens.usage: Solid gold fills: premium badges, the gold bar.

tokens.name: gradient-green
tokens.usage: Solid green fills: progress, the green bar.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: Green-to-gold: CTA band, gradient-tick, brand text. Once per page at most.

tokens.name: gradient-hero-pill
tokens.usage: HeroPill fill.

tokens.name: gradient-holo-glow
tokens.usage: Soft green light behind the hero object (gem, chart panel, tier podium). One per surface.
